bad_index_to_loc_format.ttf.reason: indexToLocFormat must be 0 or 1; any other value makes loca widths unknowable.

bad_sfnt_scaler.ttf.reason: An unrecognised sfnt scaler type (0x00020000) must be refused before any table is read.

bad_signature.bin.reason: A PNG magic number is not an sfnt scaler type; the file is not a font this library reads.

cmap_format4_start_above_end.ttf.reason: cmap format 4 startCode[0] (0x30) is above endCode[0] (0x20); the segment is impossible.

cmap_subtable_offset_outside_table.ttf.reason: The encoding record points 64 bytes past the end of cmap; the subtable window must be refused.

composite_bad_component_glyph_id.ttf.reason: A composite component names glyph 99 while maxp declares three glyphs.

composite_nesting_beyond_recursion.ttf.reason: A chain of 17 nested composites exceeds Limits.default().recursion (16) and Limits.strict().recursion (8).

composite_self_reference.ttf.reason: A composite glyph whose component is itself must be refused at the recursion ceiling, not followed forever.

composites_over_limit.ttf.reason: 1025 components exceeds Limits.default().composites (1024); the count must be checked before the glyph is walked.

contours_over_limit.ttf.reason: 32767 contours exceeds Limits.default().contours (8192); the count must be checked before the endpoint array is read.

extra_unknown_table.ttf.reason: An unrecognised table tag is legal; the directory reader must ignore it, not refuse.

glyf_contours_exceed_points.ttf.reason: Five contours are declared over only three points; each contour needs at least one endpoint.

glyf_repeat_flag_overflow.ttf.reason: A REPEAT flag declares 256 flags for a three-point glyph; expansion must be capped at numPoints.

glyf_truncated_coordinates.ttf.reason: Six points are declared but the y-coordinate run is cut short; the read must stop at the range end.

hhea_number_of_h_metrics_above_num_glyph.reason: Out of spec, but Hmtx::parse clamps numberOfHMetrics to numGlyphs; the reader must accept it without over-allocating.

loca_offset_past_glyf.ttf.reason: The final loca offset points far beyond the glyf table; reading that glyph range must be refused.

loca_offsets_going_backwards.ttf.reason: The third loca offset is below the second; glyph ranges must be monotonically non-decreasing.

long_loca_format.ttf.reason: indexToLocFormat 1 (long offsets) is valid; the control uses short offsets.

missing_cmap.ttf.reason: The cmap table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_glyf.ttf.reason: The glyf table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_head.ttf.reason: The head table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_hhea.ttf.reason: The hhea table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_hmtx.ttf.reason: The hmtx table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_loca.ttf.reason: The loca table is required and absent from the directory.

missing_maxp.ttf.reason: The maxp table is required and absent from the directory.

points_over_strict_limit.ttf.reason: A glyph declaring 8193 points exceeds Limits.strict().points (8192); under default limits it must be accepted.

table_length_over_limit.ttf.reason: A table length one byte above Limits.default().table_bytes must be refused before allocation.

table_length_past_eof.ttf.reason: The head record declares 1048576 bytes, well past EOF; the range must be refused.

table_offset_past_eof.ttf.reason: The glyf record points 4096 bytes past EOF; the directory must refuse the range before slicing.

truncated_file.bin.reason: The file is cut at byte 40, so the 144-byte directory read starting at 12 runs off the end.

ttc_count_over_glyphs_ceiling.bin.reason: A TTC declaring 65537 faces exceeds Limits.default().glyphs before any face offset is read.

unexpected_head_magic.ttf.reason: head.magicNumber is not 0x5F0F3CF5; the reader must name the expected value.

units_per_em_above_16384.ttf.reason: unitsPerEm of 16385 is one above the maximum Head::parse permits.

units_per_em_at_16384.ttf.reason: 16384 is the inclusive maximum Head::parse permits; a boundary value must be accepted.

units_per_em_zero.ttf.reason: unitsPerEm of 0 makes every later scale divide by zero; it is below the permitted minimum of 16.

unsupported_maxp_version.ttf.reason: A well-formed maxp version this library does not read must be named as unsupported.

unsupported_ttc_version.bin.reason: A TTC version this library does not read must be named as unsupported, not parsed anyway.

valid_minimal.ttf.reason: The unmodified control font; the reader must accept it with no refusal.

zero_num_tables.ttf.reason: A table directory declaring zero tables is structurally impossible.
